strategic_architecture: Shares Tymna with this project's subject deck but a materially different game plan: Mardu (W/B/R) turbo strategy using Dargo's cost-reduction (based on sacrificed-permanent value) to power creature-based infinite combos and Treasure/sacrifice synergies (e.g. Ruthless Technomancer + Cursed Mirror + Dargo for infinite Treasures), pivoting to Tymna-powered grindy midrange only when the turbo line is unavailable. Confirms Tymna-sharing pairings are not one archetype - relevant to any future Phase 8 decision about whether to model 'Tymna decks' collectively or per-pairing (this project models per-pairing, correctly per this finding). Sources: EDHREC, Learn cEDH 'Dargo Tymna'.
